title: Minimum Swaps to Group All 1's Together II
summary: A swap involves exchanging values at two unique positions in a circular array.
statement: A swap involves exchanging values at two unique positions in a circular array. Given a binary circular array, determine the least number of swaps needed to cluster all 1's together.
constraints: nums is a nonempty circular binary array.
A swap exchanges any two positions; group every one into one circularly contiguous block.
reference_solution:
def minimum_circular_one_swaps(nums):
    width=sum(nums)
    if width==0:return 0
    current=sum(nums[:width]);best=current
    for right in range(width,len(nums)+width):
        current+=nums[right%len(nums)]-nums[(right-width)%len(nums)];best=max(best,current)
    return width-best
